relsim: Seed Groups Dataset

Data viewer for paper: "Relational Visual Similarity"
📂 Project Page | 🔙 Back to Data Viewer Map | ▶️ See Anonymous Captions Dataset
Seed Groups Dataset is a collection of {image group, anonymous caption} pairs. This dataset is used to train the anonymous captioning model.
All images are extracted from the publicly available LAION dataset. Images are shown by their original Image URL. Some images may not be available because their original URLs are no longer active. We do not own any rights to the images and acknowledge the original authors of each images.

Want to download the dataset? Click on this Github Repo.
